ABOUT
:::

# I am a researcher and psychological counsellor interested in understanding psychological processes across different contexts.

::: {.about-lead}
I am a Research Assistant in the Department of Educational Sciences, Guidance and Psychological Counseling Program at the Ereğli Faculty of Education, Zonguldak Bülent Ecevit University.
:::

::: {.about-intro}
My research spans climate change and mental health, pro-environmental behaviour, psychological mechanisms, cyberbullying and cybervictimisation, poverty-sensitive school counselling, trauma-informed education, cognitive emotion regulation, and sport psychology.

I approach these areas as interconnected components of a broader research programme concerned with how psychological processes interact with environmental, social, cultural, educational, and performance contexts.
:::

SPORT & PSYCHOLOGICAL PERFORMANCE

## Connecting psychological science with performance environments

::: {.about-split}

::: {.about-split-copy}
Sport psychology is both an academic and applied part of my professional work. I have completed all three levels of the Turkish Football Federation’s Psychological Performance Consulting training and hold a UEFA Grassroots C coaching licence.

I also have coaching experience in amateur football. This provides a direct link between my academic work on sport psychology and the practical realities of performance environments.
:::
